tools.name: virtuous_get_current_organization
tools.description: Fetch the Virtuous organization this API key acts in — its name, time zone and culture, and whether the key's user is an administrator. A cheap way to confirm the key works. Virtuous: GET /api/Organization/Current.

tools.name: virtuous_search
tools.description: Full-text search across contacts, individuals and entities (campaigns, projects, segments, tags) — the same search as the Virtuous search bar. Returns hits with highlights, grouped by kind. Virtuous: POST /api/Search.

tools.name: virtuous_search_contacts
tools.description: Find contacts whose name, email, phone or address fully or partially matches a search string. Returns id, name, contact type, email, phone and address per match. Virtuous: POST /api/Contact/Search.

tools.name: virtuous_get_contact
tools.description: Fetch one contact (household, organization, foundation ...) with its address, giving summary (life-to-date, year-to-date, last gift), individuals and their contact methods, and custom fields. Virtuous: GET /api/Contact/{contactId}.

tools.name: virtuous_find_contact
tools.description: Look up a single contact by email address, or by an external reference (reference source + id, e.g. Stripe customer id). Give either email, or both reference_source and reference_id; if both are given Virtuous prioritises the reference. Virtuous: GET /api/Contact/Find.

tools.name: virtuous_list_contact_individuals
tools.description: List the individuals (people) that belong to a contact/household, with names, birth dates, and their emails and phones (contact methods). Virtuous: GET /api/ContactIndividual/ByContact/{contactId}.

tools.name: virtuous_list_contact_notes
tools.description: List the notes logged on a contact — calls, meetings, emails and other touchpoints — with type, date, text and author. Virtuous: GET /api/ContactNote/ByContact/{contactId}.

tools.name: virtuous_list_contact_note_types
tools.description: List the note types this organization accepts on a contact note (e.g. Call, Email, Visit; admins can add custom ones). Call it before virtuous_create_contact_note and pass one of these names as its type. Virtuous: GET /api/ContactNote/Types.

tools.name: virtuous_list_contact_tags
tools.description: List the tags applied to a contact (contactTagId, tagId, name). Virtuous: GET /api/ContactTag/ByContact/{contactId}.

tools.name: virtuous_list_contact_gifts
tools.description: List a contact's giving history: gift id, type, date, amount, segment and batch. Use virtuous_get_gift for designations and full detail. Virtuous: GET /api/Gift/ByContact/{contactId}.

tools.name: virtuous_get_gift
tools.description: Fetch one gift in full: contact, type, date, amount and currency, batch, segment, grant, tribute, receipt date, designations to projects, premiums and custom fields. Virtuous: GET /api/Gift/{giftId}.

tools.name: virtuous_list_tags
tools.description: List the organization's tags (id, name, tag group). Use this to find a tagId before virtuous_add_contact_tag. Virtuous: GET /api/Tag.

tools.name: virtuous_search_projects
tools.description: Find projects (funds / designations gifts are given to) by name or code, with their balances, financial need and life-to-date giving. Virtuous: POST /api/Project/Search.

tools.name: virtuous_get_project
tools.description: Fetch one project: code, type, status, balances, financial need, date range, life-to-date and calendar-year giving and gift/giver counts. Virtuous: GET /api/Project/{projectId}.

tools.name: virtuous_list_events
tools.description: List the organization's events: name, type, location, start/end, invite and RSVP counts, attendance and total giving. Virtuous: GET /api/Event.

tools.name: virtuous_get_query_options
tools.description: List the parameters, their types, allowed operators and value options that virtuous_query accepts for one record type. Call this BEFORE building a query. Virtuous: GET /api/<Resource>/QueryOptions.

tools.name: virtuous_query
tools.description: Run a Virtuous query-builder query against one record type (contacts, gifts, campaigns, projects, tasks, grants, pledges, recurring gifts, events ...). Conditions use parameter/operator names from virtuous_get_query_options. Returns { list, total }. For Contact and Gift, full_details returns full re

tools.name: virtuous_create_contact_note
tools.description: Add a note to a contact's timeline — a call, meeting, visit or other touchpoint. Writes to the donor record. Get the valid type names from virtuous_list_contact_note_types first. Virtuous: POST /api/ContactNote.

tools.name: virtuous_add_contact_tag
tools.description: Apply an existing tag to a contact (find the tagId with virtuous_list_tags). Virtuous: POST /api/ContactTag.

tools.name: virtuous_create_contact_transaction
tools.description: Submit a new or updated contact through Virtuous's import pipeline (the recommended way to add contacts). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: virtuous_search, virtuous_search_contacts, virtuous_find_contact, virtuous_list_contact_individuals, virtuous_list_contact_notes, virtuous_list_contact_note_types, virtuous_search_projects, virtuous_query, virtuous_create_contact_note · Private data: virtuous_get_current_organization, virtuous_search, virtuous_search_contacts, virtuous_get_contact, virtuous_find_contact, virtuous_list_contact_individuals, virtuous_list_contact_notes, virtuous_list_contact_note_types, virtuous_list_contact_tags, virtuous_list_contact_gifts, virtuous_get_gift, virtuous_get_query_options, virtuous_query, virtuous_create_contact_note, virtuous_add_contact_tag, virtuous_create_contact_transaction, virtuous_create_gift_transaction · Public sink: virtuous_search, virtuous_search_contacts, virtuous_find_contact, virtuous_list_contact_note_types, virtuous_search_projects, virtuous_query, virtuous_create_contact_note, virtuous_add_contact_tag, virtuous_create_contact_transaction, virtuous_create_gift_transaction · Destructive: virtuous_query, virtuous_create_contact_transaction, virtuous_create_gift_transaction.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
